title: Email: Can We Board at 14:00? Turnaround Numbers

fields.cc: Captain Anneliese Moreau; Dr. Tobias Wren; VP Communications
fields.subject: RE: Can we board at 14:00?
fields.body:
Two more things since my 08:50 note below.

09:05, call from the Gulf Terminal Services duty manager: "I've got 2,980 guests told 13:00. The first Houston airport buses leave at 10:30. I need your decision by 09:45 to re-lane the terminal, or we'll have a few thousand people on the curb."

Sales desk: 318 travel-agent bookings on the Feb 21 sailing. One agency with a 140-person group says it will move them to another line if it hears about a delay from the news first.

If we hold boarding at 14:00, the first guest message has to go out by 10:00 at the latest.

-----Original Message-----
Sent: Sun 2/21/2027 8:50 AM
Subject: Can we board at 14:00?

Colleen Abernathy-Reyes,

Numbers for the 10:00 call. 72-hour passenger trend, cumulative: 41 (Thu 18:00), 61 (Fri 06:00), 98 (Sat 12:00), 118 (Sun 02:00). The 07:00 log shows 121 passengers (4.1% of 2,980) and 32 crew (2.9% of 1,120). The latest onset was 05:40 today, so we have onsets within 48 hours.

A full outbreak clean of 1,490 cabins and all public spaces at 1,000 ppm, with soft furnishings laundered at 60 C, needs about 7.5 hours with all 380 stewards once the last guest is off at 10:30. That puts the Environmental Officer's walk-through at about 18:30. Laundry is the bottleneck: 14 tons a day.

A 14:00 boarding means signing an attestation with about 45 percent of cabins cleaned.

I need a decision I can give the terminal, the stewards and the galley.
fields.signature:
Executive Housekeeper
Shoreside Turnaround Lead, MV Halcyon Dawn
Halcyon Reach Cruises | Galveston, TX

instructorNote: This is the decision point for the boarding call under HOPRPG 7. The Master, PH and OPS should weigh the trend of cases, the most recent onsets, the cleaning status and the VSP's recommendation, then choose by 10:00: board on time with an attestation, delay in hold blocks, shorten the voyage or cancel it. Watch whether COMMS has the first guest message ready by 10:00. Booked guests, travel agents, the terminal operator, the port and the Galveston County Health District should all hear the same decision at the same time.
